title: Towards optimal selection schedules for online active learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.23477v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We consider the problem of online linear classification, where a stream of unlabeled samples is available, and annotation is costly. We investigate the optimal query policy, that prescribes whether and when a sample should be labeled and used for a training step, or instead discarded, so as to minimize a given objective. We focus on the realizable case, under Gaussian design, in the high-dimensional regime where data dimension and number of unlabeled samples grow proportionally. We consider two objectives: 1) the generalization error under a labeling budget, and 2) a cumulative cost function where mistakes have unit cost and queries cost $\Delta$. We first show that the myopic policies that greedily minimize at all times the increment in the objective correspond to either small or intermediate-margin policies, that prescribe the selection of samples whose margins fall within certain intervals that shrink with time. translated_title: 迈向在线主动学习的最优样本选择调度策略
translated_abstract: 我们研究在线线性分类问题，其中源源不断的未标注样本以数据流形式到达，而人工标注代价高昂。我们研究最优查询策略，即规定样本是否以及何时应被标注并用于一步训练，或应被直接丢弃，从而最小化给定的目标。我们聚焦于可实现情形，在高斯设计下、在数据维度与未标注样本数量成比例增长的高维区域中展开分析。我们考虑两个目标：1）在给定标注预算约束下的泛化误差；2）累积代价函数，其中每次分类错误的代价为单位成本，而每次查询的代价为 $\Delta$。我们首先证明，那些在任意时刻贪婪地最小化目标增量的短视策略对应于小间隔或中间间隔策略，即选择那些间隔落在随时间收缩的特定区间内的样本。在此类策略中，w……（摘要原文至此被截断）
tldr: 该论文在高维在线主动学习设定下证明了最优样本查询策略的本质：贪婪最小化目标增量的短视策略等价于小间隔或中间间隔选择策略，即只标注间隔落在随时间不断收缩的区间内的样本，以在标注预算或“查询代价 Δ + 错误代价”的目标下最优。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that, in high-dimensional online active learning, myopic policies that greedily minimize the objective's increment correspond to small or intermediate-margin selection schedules, which label only samples whose margins fall within time-shrinking intervals, for both budget-constrained generalization error and cumulative mistake/query cost objectives.
